about_the_game:
Clicker Astro Planet is a cosmic economic clicker game where you build a powerful space empire through growth, automation, and smart resource management.

Start with a single click and turn it into an interstellar fortune by collecting Cosmo Credits, the core currency of the game. Every upgrade multiplies your power, allowing you to scale production by tens, hundreds, and even thousands of times. Automate your empire, unlock new technologies, and dominate the galaxy!

Key Features

  • Dynamic Click System
    Every click earns Cosmo Credits. Upgrade your click power to make every tap more valuable and rewarding.

  • X2 Boost
    Temporarily double your earnings! Activate the boost whenever you want to skyrocket your profits.

  • Bonus Button
    Occasionally, a special button appears — click it for an instant surge of Cosmo Credits.

  • Upgrades & Progression
    Unlock a wide range of upgrades that enhance clicks, automation, bonuses, and more. Tailor your strategy to maximize your empire’s growth.

  • Diverse Auto-Clickers

    • Pulsing Auto-Clickers: Generate income at regular intervals.

    • Timed Auto-Clickers: Operate for a limited duration, delivering massive production boosts.

    • Production Auto-Clickers: Continuously mine Cosmo Gold, a rare resource for advanced upgrades.

  • Mini-Game "Destroyer"
    Engage in a fun asteroid-smashing mini-game to collect bonus resources and accelerate your main production.

  • Global Enhancements
    Unlock powerful global upgrades that improve the efficiency of all your production lines — current and future.

  • Full Idle Mode
    Keep earning resources even while offline. Your empire keeps growing whether you’re playing or taking a break.

Why Play Clicker Astro Planet

  • Deep and satisfying progression with layered upgrades and automation.

  • Multiple types of auto-clickers with distinct strategies.

  • Special resources to unlock and push your empire into the late game.

  • Engaging mini-game for players who love active gameplay.

  • True idle progression — your empire never stops expanding.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any with DirectX 9.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
